candidates.hypothesis: Stack the confirmed inclusion lever on the best allocation: prefer_small sources for inclusion (0.418 vs 0.326 for downscale at identical allocation, and >= uniform at comparable allocations) at the proven 25/15/10 split should lift inclusion AP50 above 0.421 while patches/scratches stay at their best levels. Confirmed if mAP50 > 0.6154 with inclusion AP50 >= 0.42 and no class dropping >0.02.

Generalize the small-source lever: missed instances are smaller than the train median for every class (33 vs 90, 53 vs 85, 40 vs 73px) and low-size-tertile recall is worst for all, so prefer_small for patches and scratches too (same 25/15/10 allocation) should raise or hold their AP50 and beat C1 on mAP50. Confirmed if mAP50 >= C1 with patches AP50 >= 0.74 and scratches AP50 >= 0.67.

Inclusion saturation: inclusion AP50 is flat ~0.38-0.42 from 30 to 65 cumulative synthetics, so shifting 5 more images from inclusion to patches (20/20/10, keeping prefer_small for inclusion) should push patches AP50 toward >=0.75 (it gained 0.708->0.745 going 10->15) without dropping inclusion below 0.40, beating C1 on mAP50. Confirmed if mAP50 > C1 with patches AP50 >= 0.75 and inclusion AP50 >= 0.40.
